zh-CN.title: 在媒体预览中引用消息和倍速播放
items: 在聊天媒体预览的左下角菜单引用原消息，返回输入框继续编辑。
按住正在播放的视频可临时以两倍速播放，松手恢复。

en.title: Quote messages and speed up videos in previews
items: Quote the original message from the chat media preview menu and continue writing in the composer.
Hold a playing video to watch at double speed, then release to resume your previous speed.
